# Closing Bell: Saudi main index closes in green at 10,878
**Arabian Drilling signs 8 more land rigs**

On the announcement front, Arabian Drilling Co. announced the signing of a new five-year contract with SLB for the provision of [eight additional land rigs for Gas LSTK operations.](https://www.saudiexchange.sa/Resources/fsPdf/28194_3703_2026-09-14_08-27-09_en.pdf)
